description: The retrieval read (S22 T6, D15/I10): a NAMED corpus (O8 — there is no default), locations with scores, NEVER content (D8 — `hits[].source` + line range is the whole product; read the file for truth). The same resolver function value answers the `search` tool and this method — one implementation, two transports. An empty index is NOT this shape: it refuses with a named reason (D2), and the no-retrieval build does not answer at all (V13). `score` is the fusion score — an ordering signal, not a probability; consumers sort by it and never interpret it.
